## Jurisdictions

**Live** — the active sync lane succeeded in the last 36 hours. **Stale** — a lane exists but has not succeeded recently. **Dormant** — bills are held but nothing is currently maintaining them. Dormant lanes are named rather than hidden.

Freshness is when a source last *reported*, not when a legislature last *acted* — a quiet chamber and a stalled feed are different things.
